versions.changelog:
Initial release of PaddleOCR-VL skill:

- GPU-accelerated document OCR using PaddleOCR-VL inside Docker.
- Detects layout and recognizes Chinese/English text, tables, charts, and seals.
- Supports vertical classical Chinese text, modern newspaper layouts, and mixed-content documents.
- Provides tools to run OCR, check environment, and demo on sample images.
- No external endpoints; all processing is local and containerized for privacy and security.
